Each file's size must stay <= its ceiling, and the ceiling only ratchets DOWN: run `node scripts/ci/check-always-loaded-budget.mjs --rebalance` after content migrates out (Moves 1/2: generation, the consult-register, skill/doc relocation) to shrink the ceiling to the new size. A net-new always-loaded addition that regrows a file past its ceiling fails the check — UNLESS the growth is justified and declared via `node scripts/ci/check-always-loaded-budget.mjs --bump <file> --reason "<why>"`, which raises that ceiling to current size and records the reason in `bumps` (tempdoc 618 §13: an explicit, auditable raise, not silent ceiling surgery). ~tokens = bytes/4.
